heading: Tuesday, July 15, 2025
topLine: Mistral releases Voxtral open speech-understanding models.

items.headline: Mistral releases Voxtral open speech-understanding models
items.summary: Voxtral is Mistral's first audio model family: a 24B model and a 3B Mini for edge use, both under Apache 2.0, handling transcription, translation and spoken Q&A with a 32k context. Mistral claims it outperforms Whisper large-v3 and beats GPT-4o mini Transcribe and Gemini 2.5 Flash on transcription.
